svg.title: Whole-house Version H: ground floor and upstairs
svg.desc: Version H preliminary two-floor diagram: about 3,805.89 square feet, 5.89 over 3,800 (ground 1,955.31, upstairs 1,850.59). Ground floor gives some area back: kitchen and prep kitchen rear walls return to the original line y7 (kitchen 11 by 19 ft 11 in, prep 15 by 8 ft); the living room top wall aligns with them (13 ft 2 in by 18 ft 8 in); the dining room extends 1 ft right and becomes 14 by 7 ft, with its depth reduced to sit north of the kitchen line. Laundry retains an 11 by 8-foot maximum envelope between drawn wall faces, now with a 1-foot-wide by 3.05-foot-deep northwest notch for Bedroom 2's bottom entry approach. The upper west wall is x32.233333 until y29.8, stepping to x31.233333 below; east wall stays x42.583333 and north/south walls stay y26.75 and y35.1. This adds 3.05 square feet of nominal gallery floor without changing exterior gross. Attic access remains direct: gallery to laundry central aisle to attic, without passing through the mechanical room. Laundry retains an 11 by 8-foot maximum envelope with the northwest entry notch. Primary closet south wall aligns with the bedroom bottom wall line y26.75, and both bedroom gallery entries stay on that wall. The lower gallery remains open; stairs, baths and bedroom sizes stay fixed. Full-size 2.8 by 2.8-foot washer and dryer stay side by side on the laundry north wall, facing south at x36.55 and x39.45, y26.925. A standard 24/24-inch north base run occupies x32.5 to 36.5; south 36/24/24-inch bases stay x31.5 to 38.5. One former attic 24-inch base swaps with the north 36-inch base to fit the notch. All seven originally labelled standard boxes remain: five in laundry and 36/24-inch bases in attic at x49.8 to 54.8, y35.3 to 37.3, labelled storage-only and support/placement approval required. No compressed or odd-width boxes are used. The original 4-foot and 6-foot overhead runs remain above the north/south bases, preserving their footprint and staying off passage and appliances; mounting/reach need product review. Gallery and attic doors align at y29.8 to 32.8 with 36-inch openings and 96-inch leaves. The gallery door swings into the gallery; the attic door at x42.583333 swings into the attic. The former mechanical-to-attic opening is closed. The mechanical room east edge moves to x42.583333, aligned with laundry, increasing its nominal clear size to about 5 ft 6 in by 5 ft. Its entry moves east to x39.35 to 42.35 at y35.1, beyond the south counter ending x38.55, and swings inward from the east hinge. The full-size 2.5 by 2-foot equipment reservation stays at x37.15 to 39.65, y38.25 to 40.25. No attic carrying route crosses the equipment space. A marked straight route at y31.32 is checked with a continuously clear 32-inch square plan proxy, doors fully open and appliance fronts/drawers closed. Static body/counter clearance is about 37.2 inches in front of machines and 45.3 inches between base counters. Bedroom 2's notched approach is about 43.6 inches wide and 32.4 inches deep between drawn wall faces: a tight turn requiring casing/occupied-use review, not a code claim. These are diagram measurements, not occupied-comfort, product, code or mechanical-service approval. Machine doors and drawers temporarily obstruct the attic route: close them before passing. Casing, handles, installations, headroom, attic flooring/loads/guards/framing, cabinet support and mechanical service/combustion/fire separation require review. Primary bedroom remains 14 by 19 feet, with west wall x0 aligned to stair/Bath 3 and east divider x14.35. Primary bath/closet and right-hand rooms retain their 9-inch leftward shift. Bedroom 2 remains about 14 by 13 feet: north divider y13.4, south wall y26.75; exactly 13 feet deep between drawn 0.35-foot walls and 13.983333 feet wide. Bath 2 is about 8 ft 8 in by 5 ft 8 in, Closet 2 about 5 ft by 6 ft 8 in; full-size furnishings, fixtures and storage remain. Primary media console follows its divider; the second primary reading chair moves 13.2 inches west to clear the new bedroom door swing. All furnishings retain their full size. Stairs/arrival, ground floor and front bedrooms remain fixed. Laundry and mechanical east walls align at x42.583333; lower garage stays fixed, attic remains unfinished and uncounted, and rear wall stays straight. Primary bath is about 13 ft 7 in by 11 ft 3 in after the primary closet moved 1 foot south; the tub-to-vanity walkway is about 76.5 inches. A generic full-size 33.6 by 62.4-inch tub is rotated 90 degrees to run east-west along the rear wall at x18.59 to 23.79, y7.75 to 10.55, centered between the WC and the shower. It uses the existing tub proxy footprint, not a selected product or an approved built-in installation. The 60-inch vanity sits on the southwest south wall, x14.85 to 19.85, y16.925 to 18.825; the 48-inch vanity and 42 by 72 inch shower stay full size and in place. The private WC gets a 30-inch inward-swing south opening at x14.9 to 17.4, y12.675; its toilet moves 1.8 inches north to clear the swing. Both bathroom entries remain fixed. Diagram body clearances: tub to south vanities about 64.5 inches of open floor, tub to shower about 7.3 inches and tub to WC east wall face about 5.3 inches. The side gaps are not passages: approach the tub from the south. Drawn strokes and selected fixtures, handles, taps, trim and installation/service needs can reduce these gaps. No operating or product approval is implied. Primary closet is a full rectangle from x14.35 to 28.25, y19 to 26.75, about 13 ft 7 in by 7 ft 5 in between drawn wall faces. Its south wall aligns with both bedroom walls at y26.75; the bath took 1 foot from the top of the closet. Exterior gross is unchanged. Two 5 by 2 foot hanging bays sit at y21.45 to 26.45, keeping the 0.7-foot gap below the drawer bank and shelves and retaining the 39.6-inch body-to-body aisle, about 38.8 including strokes. The 48-inch drawer bank, 2 by 2.05 foot return hanging and 10.08-square-foot shelf footprint remain. The 30-inch bath-to-closet opening is x20.7 to 23.2 at y19, swinging into the bath. The primary bedroom gallery entry is x10.85 to 13.85 at y26.75, hinged east and opening into the bedroom. Bedroom 2 entry is x28.85 to 31.85 at the same y26.75, hinged west and opening into Bedroom 2. Both are 36 by 96 inches; former side gallery openings are filled. Bath 4 remains 9 by 5 ft, Bedrooms 3 and 4 12 by 13 ft, Closet 4 6 by 5 ft. Ground retains 15 by 7 foot prep kitchen, 13 by 8 foot dining, 11 by 19 foot kitchen, 12 ft by 7 ft 10 in kids room, 12 by 12 foot guest room, 12 ft by 5 ft 6.5 in guest bath and 12 by 14 foot office. Exterior-face gross areas: upstairs 1,850.5858, unchanged ground 1,909.9352, combined 3,760.5210 square feet, using model baseline with diagram exterior adjustments. Mechanical east alignment adds about 2.5858 square feet; closet/door changes reallocate internal floor only. Garage, porch, basement and unfinished attic are not counted. Diagram clearances are not occupied, product, accessibility or code approval. Structure, roofs, fire separation, HVAC, fixtures, appliances and operating clearances need professional review. Only this SVG is changed; the 3D model is unchanged.
svg.text: Version H: whole house under 3,800 sq ft
PRELIMINARY DIAGRAM ONLY | 3,805.89 sq ft finished gross (both floors) | 5.89 above 3,800 | starts from Version G upstairs
Rear / north at top; street / front at bottom. Same 1-ft scale on both floors. Red hatch = area removed from the current design.
Tub restored; selected-product fit and operating approval unresolved.

g.text: South of storage: garage roof only
-104.04 vs G: lined up with bedroom
Upstairs: primary narrowed 9 in; bath/closet and right rooms shifted left
Primary tub rotated to run along the rear wall; shower and both vanities kept.
Bath 1 ft deeper (11'3"); closet 7'5", bottom aligned with bedrooms.
Primary 14' x 19'; Bed 2 14' x 13'; Bath 2 8'8" x 5'8"; laundry 11' x 8' max.
Kitchen 11' x 19'11" and prep 15' x 8': rear walls back out. Dining 14' x 7'.
Kids room 12' x 7'10": north wall straight with kitchen; guest 12' x 12', bath 12' x 5'6.5".
Office 12' x 14'; powder room and alcove about 4 in shallower.
Living 13'2" x 18'8": top wall aligned with the kitchen; front wall unchanged.
Laundry entry notch clears Bedroom 2; standard cabinet sizes retained.
Direct attic route: aligned doors across laundry; no passage through mechanical.
Bedrooms 3 / 4, Closets 3 / 4 and Baths 3 / 4; attic remains unfinished.
Area check against 3,800 sq ft gross
Upstairs Bath 2 / Bedroom 2 block lined up
Ground prep kitchen 15 x 8 (3-ft east cut)
Ground dining 14 x 7; living 1 ft deeper
East/west and wing cuts; mech alignment adds 2.59
Mech edge aligned; door beyond laundry cabinets; direct attic path kept.
Exterior-face gross incl. walls and stairs, less the actual stair gap; ground
baseline from model area function with SVG adjustments. Garage, porch, basement and
unfinished attic are not counted. Tax effect of this cut is small
(roughly $500-1,000 / yr); the larger saving is construction cost.

svg.text: Exterior steps need roof / trim review: rear dining bump, 3-ft east prep step, straight upstairs rear wall.
Generic footprints, not selected products. Structure, over-garage floor, roofs, fire separation, HVAC and plumbing need professional review; the 3D model is unchanged.
